notes: The San Francisco Planning Commission's minutes of its meetings of 1999, from volume 46 of the San Francisco Public Library's deposit at the Internet Archive (46minutesofsanfran1999san, labelled 1999). Action minutes, as in 1994 - 1998: each calendar item prints its case number and planner, the property with its assessor's block and lot, the request, the speakers by name, and the action with the vote list and the motion or resolution number. This batch was read by an external reader (Meta Muse, working from the Internet Archive's one-file djvu text, which has no page breaks) from a written spec, and converted here: every entry's page was then located mechanically in the hOCR page split by its case number, its meeting date and its verbatim quote (976 of 1,001 quotes matched a page of the right meeting exactly; the rest by case number and meeting date, and nine by hand from the case number's OCR). Pages were split from the hOCR search text on the Internet Archive page index (first two fields are the text offsets), counting the viewer page among the leaves scandata.xml does not mark addToAccessFormats=false. Four kinds of finding: what the Commission (or, reported in the minutes, the Board of Supervisors or Board of Permit Appeals) decided about a property, dated to the meeting that decided it; what the calendar states stood on or occupied the property; landmark actions; and a dated past fact the calendar prints. A continuance, a motion of intent, a failed motion and an item under 'Items to be continued' are not decisions. Rows read before 15 April 1999 were written to an earlier version of the spec that dropped lettered lots and kept one lot of several; those lots are recovered here from address_as_written, and where the quote was the bare action word the request clause is prefixed from the cited page with ' ... '. A duplicated 63-67 Glover Street occupancy (7 and 14 January 1999) is kept once. The minutes name applicants, owners, neighbours, objectors, commissioners and staff in every item; none of them is in any field, and commissioner names the reader put in two notes are removed.

coverage.remaining: Every meeting of volume 46 (46minutesofsanfran1999san, labelled 1999) was read: 44 meetings, 7 January to 16 December 1999. Regular meetings were cancelled for 8 and 29 April, 1 and 29 July, 30 September, 11 and 25 November, and 23 and 30 December. Next: volume 47 (January - April 2000).
